method: Read public HTML, JavaScript chunks and CSS over HTTP only. No browser used for this research/revision. Source declarations are not an observed runtime trace.

textSkeleton.alignment: centered vertically within actual measured text line; real width retained

pulse.scope: measured-layout container, not one animation per line

ordinaryExpansion.fadeStarts: after height transition end and stable layout, next animation frame

launch.caveat: launch branch crossfades without ordinary height expansion; first content reveal is coordinated through whenLaunchEntered, not immediately after DOM measurement

projectAdoption.textStroke: center measured lines; clamp font-size/2 to .375–.625 root rem (normally 6–8px on this site), preserve actual line width and center
projectAdoption.entrances: Latest user instruction: SSR splash -> measured skeleton at final natural height -> top-to-bottom staggered opacity; only SPA retains two placeholders -> measured skeleton -> height expansion.
projectAdoption.splash: One-shot official HeartHandshake motion slowed from 700ms to 1260ms; when ready in time, fade Splash from 860ms to 1260ms, wait 200ms, then fade the measured skeleton/container in for 512ms. Late data holds the final icon pose without replay. SPA unchanged.

textFadeStarts.SSR: After settle interval, 180ms opacity fade with 50ms row stagger; no height/translate animation
textFadeStarts.SPA: After each 400ms height expansion, replacing the old 120ms early reveal

projectAdoption.pulseScope: one inner layer per card; outer layer handles exit fade; pause until measured geometry becomes visible
projectAdoption.validation: Code/manual source review only for this revision. Prior desktop checks cover older timing and thicker line geometry, not this revision.
projectAdoption.sourceRechecked: 2026-10-16: public launch JS and CSS fetched over HTTP again; 860ms fade start, 400ms fade, 1460ms feed start and 512ms feed fade declarations still present. No browser/runtime validation.
